systems.system: Online payment of fixed penalties for traffic offences
systems.platform: Supreme Court Portal, with MauPass sign-in and payment by MauCAS QR code applications or card
systems.owner: Not stated; the Mauritius Police Force enters the Fixed Penalty Notice into the system
systems.tiers: Public, from 30 October 2026, for offences not carrying penalty points and only where the police have entered the notice; a second phase is to cover all traffic offences and speed-camera notices

systems.country_label: Photographic Enforcement Device Notices; speed cameras

note: Cabinet highlights; the police matter is online payment of traffic fines, a single function, and nothing is said of how stations record a report or a case.
